## What is NextGen Lead Generator?

NextGen Lead Generator is a tool created by Muhammad Affaf that helps agencies find high-intent clients on Google Maps. It was developed by Muhammad Affaf from NextGen Analytics in Karachi, Pakistan.

- Finds Web Development clients (no website) - Ticket $300-$800
- Finds Marketing clients (low rating) - Ticket $400-$1000/mo
- Finds Power BI / Fabric clients (100+ reviews but no dashboard) - Ticket $950+ HIGH TICKET
- Triple System with Stop Button
- 195 countries supported
- Built with Python, Playwright, Flask, Pandas, Streamlit
